notes.title: Free KINE demo!
notes.content:
Kine is a charming 3D puzzle game about three musical machines hoping to find their big break. Guide these dreamers through a delightful tale of love, labor, and loss as they struggle to form a band and find success on the main stage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32384430/0e47d156306b7b3edf29b6c58297af90bea866b0.gif[/img]

Kine was truly a labor of love. This game started as one solo-developers after-work passion project, and grew into the multi-platform 6+ hour puzzle game that it is today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32384430/e9c93dafdedaa3a10e4b6518b572e0bc7aaa8cc2.gif[/img]

KINE will launch Oct 19th. Just over a week from now! 

- Please check out the demo
- Please [b]wishlist[/b] the game if you enjoy it!

Every wishlist [i]really[/i] helps me out right now <3

https://store.steampowered.com/app/824570/Kine/
